prompts.hub: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 EDIT TARGET is the existing portrait settlement screen. Image 2 is STYLE ONLY reference: our approved character sprite sheet with bold angular black ink masses. Restyle image 1 to match image 2. Preserve exact portrait aspect ratio, building silhouettes, layout, camera, all signs and UI button locations. Change the rendering significantly: broad irregular angular BLACK SHADOW SHAPES below roofs, inside doorways, on stone side faces, beneath beams, around statue and vegetation. Ink dark fantasy illustration with decisive broken thick contours and 2-3 angular cel-shading values, muted ash greys, dirty ochre and desaturated umber. No soft gradients, smooth plastic bevels or overall dark filter. Lit surfaces remain readable. Paving should be comparatively quiet and low contrast so residents read clearly. Reduce orange saturation and bloom; small amber flame/window accents only. Simplify minor texture instead of adding scratch noise. Residents retain torso silhouettes but have angular ink shadow faces and clothing like image 2, not cute faceless round toys. Distant scenery remains subdued. KEEP Korean text exactly and in place: 원정문, 상점, 요양소, 숙소, 훈련장, 편집, 출정. Keep top header blank. Do not add text or HUD. This is a drop-in background; preserve all original positions. Strong unmistakable large ink shadows, not merely thicker outlines.
prompts.materials: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 EDIT TARGET is a square 4x4 equal-cell dungeon MATERIAL atlas. Image 2 STYLE ONLY reference is our approved bold ink character art. Restyle ALL 16 cells to this angular ink style, preserve exact cell grid, material identities, layout and edge-to-edge opaque coverage. No margins or labels. Distinct angular black shadow wedges along stone undersides, chips and wood joints; bold broken ink contours, 2-3 flat shading values, subdued grey and umber, no gradients, plastic bevel, noise or tiny repetitive cracks. Keep FLOOR cells lower contrast and quieter than wall cells and character art, not black pits. Preserve row1 four large warm-grey flagstone floor variants. Row2 col1 FRONT WALL: top25% horizontal continuous coping band, lower75% three courses of cool-grey masonry; no perspective, no corner, no endcaps. Row2 col2 TOP WALL: cool-grey stone viewed straight down, no facade. Row2 col3 wood planks; col4 dark metal plates. Row3 dark desaturated blue water, water with simple ripple, mud, mossy slabs. Row4 flat ground rubble, packed earth, scorched slabs with restrained embers, damp flagstone. Wall shadows stronger than floor. Broad intentional black ink shapes in masonry and metal; maintain material midtones. Strict 4x4 opaque material atlas, all cells fill their complete square. Preserve geometry for procedural wall assembly.
prompts.props: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 EDIT TARGET is our 4x4 prop sprite sheet. Image 2 STYLE ONLY reference is our character parts sheet: match its strong angular BLACK INK SHADOW MASSES and sharp broken outlines. Redraw the SAME 16 objects with original silhouettes, same order and cell positions. One square image, 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows. Each object must fit within its cell with 10% transparent margin. REAL TRANSPARENT alpha outside objects and through openings, no black backdrop, checkerboard, ground plane, ground shadow, glow halo, labels or grid. Grey stone, dull iron, desaturated umber wood, restrained amber flame and pale cyan relic. Large asymmetrical black shapes on undersides and side faces, 2-3 flat angular highlight/shadow regions, chipped ink edges. No smooth gradients, shiny 3D bevels or noisy hatching. Preserve: row1 broken pillar, rock pile, wooden crate, barrel; row2 lit wall torch, unlit torch, brazier, campfire; row3 locked chest, dirt mound with slab, sarcophagus, altar; row4 cyan relic pedestal, portcullis arch, bone pile, crossed-plank barricade. Entire sprites isolated, no clipping or overlap. Match character reference's harsh graphic chiaroscuro, not a glossy cartoon icon set.
